title: Syrian-Style Pilaf with Hearty Croutons
description: A flavorful pilaf dish from Syria, served with crunchy croutons and a hint of butter.
instructions: Toss the bread cubes with butter until well coated.
Spread the bread mixture on a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
In a large saucepan, heat 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the Syrian rice and pilaf, stir to combine.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add salt and black pepper to taste, then stir to combine.
To assemble the dish, place the cooked rice mixture in a serving bowl and top with the croutons.
Serve hot, garnished with additional butter and croutons if desired.
